name: Jayden Okonkwo
psychographics: Prioritizes work-life balance; sees household management as a system to be optimized, not a hobby.
current_solutions: Uses 'SkipTheDishes' for lunch, 'Amazon Fresh' for bulk staples, and a meal-kit service 'HelloFresh' focused on 15-minute recipes.
frustration: Yesterday at 12:15 PM, his SkipTheDishes order for a business lunch was marked 'delivered' but was actually left at the building's security desk; he didn't find it until 2:00 PM, missed his client call, and had to order emergency sushi.
decision_style: Relies on driver rating history; will pay extra for a 4.9-rated driver over a cheaper option.
voice: Formal and precise. Uses business jargon like 'KPIs' and 'deliverables' even when talking about dinner.
